text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, lamotrigine 150 mg immediate‑release tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 106 tablets (18.1 days at 5.8 tablets/day). Corvale General holds 218 tablets (28.2 days at 7.7 tablets/day). Par Health, Inc. posted a discontinuation for lamotrigine extended‑release tablets on 2026-04-29; this does not affect the immediate‑release product we stock.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows lamotrigine is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A rule‑based check notes FDA actions or weak links exist but no action before a posting at a registered plant, so current supply commitments should be verified.

Our position: Immediate‑release inventory covers roughly three to four weeks. No FDA shortage listing exists for this presentation. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify current supply commitments with Actavis Pharma, Inc. and place orders as appropriate; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to verify current supply commitments with Advagen Pharma Limited and place orders as appropriate; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to verify current supply commitments with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC and place orders as appropriate; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to verify current supply commitments with Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. and place orders as appropriate; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to verify current supply commitments with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited and place orders as appropriate; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
